description_policy: Descriptions are paraphrased capture summaries, not verbatim source text. description_raw is null.
tag_policy: Page-level tags remain separate. Only explicit per-skill list entries and inline section tag prefixes are attached. Null tags mean no section-level mapping was recorded in this batch.

sections.name: Force of Nature
sections.description_summary: Selects a tile and calls lightning on enemies within 2 tiles, then leaves a dark cloud for 7 s. The cloud repeatedly strikes controlled enemies below, with a per-enemy interval.

sections.name: Entangling Vines
sections.description_summary: Entangles the two closest enemies for 2 s, preventing movement/actions and dealing damage over time; prioritizes enemies under the dark cloud.

sections.name: Nature's Resilience
sections.description_summary: Recovers Energy whenever a non-summoned enemy is controlled, with a per-enemy cooldown.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: Increases ATK.

sections.name: Spring Thunderstorm
sections.description_summary: Casts Entangling Vines on all enemies under the dark cloud once after Force of Nature.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: Reduces the lightning strike interval for the same enemy.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: Provides Energy recovery per second; after three Ultimates adds ATK, with higher ranks adding true damage to all enemies.

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: Provides separate Ultimate-triggered damage/Energy effects and refine stats.

sections.name: Frozen Grave
sections.description_summary: Freezes the selected enemy for 6 s and creates an arctic field applying Frostbite to the target and enemies within 2 tiles. Each Frostbite stack reduces Haste for 6 s, up to three.

sections.name: Freezing Nova
sections.description_summary: Damages the target and adjacent enemies and applies Frostbite.

sections.name: Snowball Witchery
sections.description_summary: Surrounds Carolina with four snowballs; automatically fires one every 3 s at enemies under control effects. Replenishes snowballs after use.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: Increases Crit; grants extra Crit after five Snowball Witchery casts.

sections.name: Ice Vortex
sections.description_summary: Each Snowball Witchery cast permanently increases snowball damage up to seven stacks; from the third cast, new snowballs deal AOE damage and reduce Magic DEF.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: Snowball Witchery damage also applies Frostbite.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: Under a stationary-tile condition, after 3 s increases damage and Haste; higher ranks add shield/steadfast.

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: Provides separate Ultimate-triggered damage/Energy effects and refine stats.

sections.name: Echo of Silence
sections.description_summary: Before battle chooses Spellbind (prevents Ultimate casts) or Curelock (prevents healing others). Summons Bell of Order; active order binds all non-boss units on both sides for 6 s. Bell is also summoned at battle start and persists 12 s.

sections.name: Grand Resonance
sections.description_summary: Fires a frontal shockwave that hits enemies four times; while order is active, Dunlingr takes less damage.

sections.name: Clemency Chime
sections.description_summary: Protects the farthest non-summoned ally from Dunlingr's own order until they are defeated.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: On Ultimate, grants all allies ATK SPD if Spellbind or Life Drain if Curelock. LV 2 adds order-specific enemy Energy/Haste reduction or HP/Vitality reduction when Bell order ends or refreshes.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: Provides opening and periodic shields for allies within 2 tiles; higher ranks add damage reduction.

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: Provides separate low-HP mitigation/healing effects and refine stats.

sections.name: Farthest-teammate targeting
sections.description_summary: The page specifies farthest teammate selection with a hex-ID tie-break; preserved as a separate targeting record.

sections.name: Running Tide
sections.description_summary: Sends a 3-tile-wide wave in the selected direction, damaging and knocking back enemies.

sections.name: Undercurrent
sections.description_summary: Creates a water column beneath an enemy, knocks them airborne, damages and stuns them.

sections.name: Tidal Strength
sections.description_summary: At battle start blesses the nearest ally, prioritizing the ally behind Cassadee. When the blessed ally hits with normal attacks, Cassadee adds magic damage; the blessing has a trigger count and cooldown before reapplication.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: Increases Haste; grants extra Haste while the first blessed ally remains alive.

sections.name: Tidal Blessing
sections.description_summary: Allies in the path of Running Tide gain temporary blessings that empower their next normal attacks with Tidal Strength. Later levels trigger Undercurrent after enough hits.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: Running Tide reduces Magic DEF of enemies hit. LV 2 makes Tidal Strength permanent, grants Penetration and raises trigger rate.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: Provides Energy recovery per second; after three Ultimates adds ATK, with higher ranks adding true damage to all enemies.

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: Provides separate Ultimate-triggered damage/Energy effects and refine stats.

sections.name: Ally selection by hex distance
sections.description_summary: The page specifies ally selection by hex distance and hex ID; preserved as separate targeting metadata.

sections.name: Blast Mayhem
sections.description_summary: Passive normal attacks explode on the target and adjacent units; all Kulu skills damage both enemies and allies, but allies take reduced damage. Active bombardment hits random enemy-side tiles, then summons gigantified Boomboom to damage all units on the enemy side. Kulu is unaffected/invincible while casting.

sections.name: Boomboom Bash!
sections.description_summary: Boomboom bounces between frontmost enemies, devours them, then releases them on the rearmost enemy-side target; deals damage and reduces movement speed. Devoured enemies cannot act/attack and only take Boomboom damage.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: Increases ATK from battle start and stacks when dealing damage.

sections.name: Bombs Away!
sections.description_summary: Applies an explosive debuff to all enemies, increasing damage taken. Defeated enemies become doom bombs that explode after 2 s. Higher levels increase blast damage and expand explosion radius during Blast Mania.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: Grants ATK SPD and Ranged DEF based on the number of enemies on Kulu's half; allies on her half receive part of these bonuses.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: Adds critical-hit splash damage; higher ranks convert part of critical damage into a permanent shield.

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: Provides separate normal-attack stacking effects and refine stats.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: Each Whirl Assault also reduces target Vitality for 3 s. LV 2 improves First Strike damage, grants ATK SPD while Blade Vortex is active, and adds lost-HP-based damage to normal attacks against the First Strike target. If allied Isabella is deployed, Shield of Light also grants Isabella an equal shield.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: Increases damage dealt and damage reduction, stronger while on the enemy side. Higher ranks add a permanent shield on first entry to the enemy side.

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: Provides separate opening/assist/defeat stats and refine effects.

sections.name: Shadow Strike
sections.description_summary: Flashes to an enemy, hits repeatedly, freezes briefly, then jumps for extra damage. Seth becomes invincible and heals based on total damage dealt; prioritizes the weakest enemy.

sections.name: Predator's Lunge
sections.description_summary: Pounces on the weakest enemy, dealing ATK damage plus lost-HP-based extra damage.

sections.name: Hunter Instinct
sections.description_summary: Bloodlust stacks when a non-summoned enemy first falls below an HP threshold; stacks permanently increase Haste and Life Drain. First Bloodlust also grants Phys/Magic DEF.

capture_status_notes: The capture excerpt ends during Hunter Instinct; remaining Hero Focus, Exclusive Equipment, Enhance Force, Season Charm and Rivalry Mode require recapture.

sections.name: Royal Prerogative
sections.description_summary: Gaining Supporters grants Authority stacks, increasing damage dealt, reducing damage taken and extending Sear duration. At three stacks, Sear silences enemies after 3 s and reduces Vitality.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: After three Authority stacks, Orion becomes unaffected for the rest of battle and Sear deals extra true damage.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: Increases damage dealt and damage reduction, stronger while on the enemy side; higher ranks add a permanent shield on first entry to the enemy side.

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: Provides a separate timed defensive/offensive effect and refine stats.

capture_status_notes: The returned excerpt begins at Exclusive Equipment; page-level tags and base abilities are not visible. Recapture from the beginning for Ultimate, base skills, Hero Focus and page tags.

sections.name: "Salamander" Natsu
sections.description_summary: When Natsu deals damage, reduces the target's max HP by 40% of actual damage dealt, with non-boss and per-target caps. Higher rank increases the reduction.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: Whenever Natsu causes HP loss by means other than normal attacks, burns the target for 5 s, dealing damage every 0.5 s.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: Provides Energy recovery per second; after three Ultimates adds ATK, with higher ranks adding true damage to all enemies.

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: Provides a separate timed defensive/offensive effect and refine stats.

capture_status_notes: The returned excerpt begins at Exclusive Equipment; base abilities and page tags are not visible. Recapture from the beginning for full kit, page tags and Hero Focus.

sections.name: Thousandfold Edge
sections.description_summary: Becomes invincible and performs eight strikes against random enemies, applying Sword Mark. The final hit detonates all marks for true damage to nearby enemies; repeated mark explosions on the same enemy deal reduced subsequent damage. Each successful Duel adds two strikes.

sections.name: Duelist's Gambit
sections.description_summary: After battle begins, teleports to the rearmost enemy in each column and challenges them to a 4 s Duel. During Duel, both heroes prioritize each other and can only use normal attacks. If Thane survives with at least 20% HP, the Duel succeeds, restores HP and permanently increases basic stats.

sections.name: Crosscut Flurry
sections.description_summary: Performs three slashes along a line through the target; counts as a normal attack. Cooldown resets when Thane starts a Duel.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: Increases ATK SPD, with extra ATK SPD after the first successful Duel.
